HISTORICAL VOTER REGISTRATION STATISTICS FOR 154-DAY CLOSE
FOR STATEWIDE DIRECT PRIMARIES IN GUBERNATORIAL ELECTION YEARS

Report Date Eligible Voters1 Registered Voters Percent
January 4, 20222 26,976,858 22,005,243 81.57%
January 2, 2018 25,076,348 18,980,481 75.69%
December 31, 2013 24,056,843 17,660,257 73.41%
January 5, 2010 23,289,360 16,909,574 72.61%
January 3, 2006 22,550,376 15,810,412 70.11%
October 2, 20013 21,364,576 15,336,856 71.79%
1The figures given are unofficial but are based on U.S. Census data, as adjusted by information from the California Department of Finance and
the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation.
2Due to the delay in Census information as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic which subsequently affected the release of redistricting maps
by the California Citizens Redistricting Commission, this 154-Day Report of Registration contains the number of voters, by party preferences,
in each county, city, and unincorporated area. The 88-Day Report of Registration will include the number of voters, by party preferences, in
each Supervisorial, State Senate, State Assembly, Board of Equalization, and Congressional District.
3 The 2002 Statewide Direct Primary was conducted in March rather than June.
